models.name: stg_documents
models.description: Documents (registration cards, policies, inspections, permits) matched to a vehicle by its id, plate or VIN

models.name: stg_sites
models.description: Sites with productive technician hours per day

models.name: stg_vehicles
models.description: Vehicles with identity (VIN status, decoded year and make), time in service, age, book value and registration / insurance status (latest of the vehicle file and its documents)

models.name: stg_drivers
models.description: Drivers with licence status (valid, expiring, expired), days left, site and region

models.name: stg_energy
models.description: Fuel and charging rows, priced (actual or fleet.yml) and converted to CO2

models.name: stg_feedback
models.description: Customer ratings attributed to a site and region (via the work order when linked)

models.name: stg_fines
models.description: Fines registered against vehicles, with region, month, unpaid flag and the responsible driver (named on the fine, else the driver on a trip that day, else the vehicle's assigned driver)

models.name: stg_gcc_rules
models.description: Published vehicle-compliance rules for the six GCC countries (registration, insurance, inspection, operating card), each with its authority, source and confidence. See docs/GCC_COMPLIANCE.md for review dates and Bahrain's class-based inspection rule.

models.name: stg_parts_orders
models.description: Parts orders with lead time, promised vs actual arrival, days late and open / overdue flags

models.name: stg_recall_vehicles
models.description: Vehicles affected by each recall campaign, with launch date and region

models.name: stg_service_contacts
models.description: Points of contact at the manufacturers' service centres, by brand, region and desk

models.name: stg_trips
models.description: Trips or period summaries from telematics, with the vehicle's region and site and the driver (from the trip, else the vehicle's assigned driver)

models.name: stg_usage
models.description: Distance and operating hours, daily or monthly

models.name: stg_vehicle_addons
models.description: Equipment fitted beyond the base trim (chargers, battery packs, self-driving hardware, cameras, telematics, body fit-outs), with its own warranty status

models.name: stg_warranties
models.description: Warranty cover per vehicle with its status by date and by kilometres (Active, Expiring, Expired, Expired (km), Void), days and km left

models.name: stg_work_orders
models.description: Work orders with the three clocks (key-to-key, workshop, fleet), time to pick up, back to operations, issue category and goodwill

models.name: int_downtime_monthly
models.description: Off-road hours per vehicle-month (key in -> back in operations; open jobs count elapsed hours to the snapshot)

models.name: int_energy_vehicle_month
models.description: Litres, kWh, energy cost, CO2 and fuelling / charging time per vehicle-month

models.name: int_maintenance_vehicle_month
models.description: Fleet-paid maintenance cost and job count per vehicle-month (OEM / insurance work excluded from cost)

models.name: int_vehicle_months
models.description: One row per vehicle per month in service, with distance, hours and month-end book value

models.name: int_pm_status
models.description: Preventive-maintenance state per active vehicle (km or months since last service vs powertrain interval)

models.name: int_site_month_productivity
models.description: Technician productivity per site-month = billed labour hours / available productive hours

models.name: int_site_weekly
models.description: Weekly workshop performance per site with an INTERVENE / WATCH / OK flag (complete weeks, recalls excluded, 14-day warm-up)

models.name: int_vehicle_month_economics
models.description: Vehicle-month economics inside the KPI window: energy, maintenance, depreciation, CO2

models.name: int_visits
models.description: Unplanned workshop visits with the gap to the previous visit and to the previous repair of the same issue (repeat logic)

models.name: mart_driver_compliance
models.description: Driver compliance profile: licence valid and of the class the assigned vehicle needs, fines (count, amount, unpaid) and tickets opened on the driver (jobs where they were at the wheel) or by the driver (jobs they reported), with a status and the reasons

models.name: mart_alerts
models.description: The alert rules engine: telematics trips and driver licences checked against the limits in fleet.yml (alerts:); one row per vehicle or driver over a limit in the alert window

models.name: mart_asset_value_monthly
models.description: Fleet acquisition cost, book value and depreciation by month and powertrain

models.name: mart_backlog
models.description: Open work at the snapshot per site: aging buckets and days of backlog (open jobs / average daily completions, last 28 days)

models.name: mart_compliance_calendar
models.description: Registration and insurance renewals due per week for the next 13 weeks (plus overdue)

models.name: mart_compliance_expiring
models.description: Active vehicles whose registration or insurance is expired or expiring, most urgent first

models.name: mart_compliance_status
models.description: Registration and insurance status of the active fleet, by region

models.name: mart_cost_monthly
models.description: Fleet-paid maintenance vs budget by region and month (budgets file, else fleet.yml rate x vehicle-months)

models.name: mart_customer_monthly
models.description: Customer satisfaction by region and month: responses, average stars, CSAT (4-5 stars), 1-2 star share

models.name: mart_customer_site
models.description: Customer satisfaction and 1-2 star ratings per site, KPI window

models.name: mart_document_coverage
models.description: Document coverage for active vehicles: how many have a registration card and an insurance policy on file, and in what status

models.name: mart_driver_scores
models.description: Driving behaviour per driver over the alert window: distance, idle share, speeding and harsh events per 100 km, a 0-100 safety score with a band, and licence status

models.name: mart_energy_monthly
models.description: Energy cost and CO2 per km by powertrain and month

models.name: mart_pm_compliance
models.description: Preventive-maintenance compliance by region, home site and powertrain

models.name: mart_fines_monthly
models.description: Fines registered by region, month and type: count, amount and unpaid amount

models.name: mart_fleet_monthly
models.description: Availability and utilisation by region and month

models.name: mart_goodwill_monthly
models.description: Goodwill by region and month: amount waived, share of service spend and share of jobs with goodwill

models.name: mart_handover_monthly
models.description: The three clocks and the handover by region and month: workshop, time to pick up, back to operations, total off-road

models.name: mart_key_to_key_monthly
models.description: Key-to-key time (key in to key back) by region and month, recalls excluded

models.name: mart_repeat_monthly
models.description: Repeat visits (back within the repeat window for any reason) and repeat repairs (same issue fixed again) by region and month

models.name: mart_region_month_kpis
models.description: Every monthly KPI by region and month: the input to the executive scorecard and trends

models.name: mart_exec_scorecard
models.description: Executive scorecard: one row per region for the report month, every KPI with its RAG status

models.name: mart_fines_vehicle
models.description: Fines per vehicle, all time in the data: the repeat offenders and the unpaid balance

models.name: mart_fleet_registry
models.description: The fleet register: one row per vehicle with identity (VIN, plate, make, model, year, trim, configuration), compliance and documents, and its service record

models.name: mart_gcc_compliance
models.description: Each active vehicle checked against its GCC country's published rules (stg_gcc_rules): one status (Non-compliant, Evidence missing, Expiring, Compliant, or Not covered outside the six countries) and the reasons in plain words. A check of the records on file, not a certification.

models.name: mart_issue_categories
models.description: Common repair and issue categories by powertrain, KPI window: volume, share, cost, key-to-key and repeat rate

models.name: mart_job_outcomes
models.description: One row per closed work order: the three clocks, parts wait, repeat flags, cost, goodwill and (when given) the customer's rating, for job-level statistics

models.name: mart_key_to_key_distribution
models.description: Key-to-key time histogram by job type, KPI window

models.name: mart_site_scores
models.description: Site Ops Score (0-1,000) for the current and previous 4-week periods; every component is an existing KPI

models.name: mart_leaderboard
models.description: Site league table: rank, tier, movement, clean-week streak and badges

models.name: mart_metric_panel
models.description: Region x month panel behind the metric network: exact identities (north star = visit rate x hours per visit; hours per visit = workshop + pick-up + back to ops + still open) next to every KPI, unrounded

models.name: mart_network_trends
models.description: Network-wide monthly series for every headline KPI (sparklines and trend charts)

models.name: mart_parts_eta
models.description: Parts ETA reliability by supplier and month of arrival: orders, on-time %, average days late, lead time

models.name: mart_parts_open
models.description: Parts still on order at the snapshot, most overdue first: the vehicles waiting on a promise

models.name: mart_powertrain_kpis
models.description: Cost per km (energy + maintenance + depreciation), efficiency and CO2 by powertrain, KPI window

models.name: mart_productivity
models.description: Technician productivity per site and month (billed / available hours)

models.name: mart_rating_distribution
models.description: Star-rating distribution by region, KPI window

models.name: mart_recall_completion
models.description: Recall completion by campaign and region

models.name: mart_recall_curve
models.description: Cumulative recall completion by week since launch, per campaign and region

models.name: mart_repeat_site
models.description: Repeat visits and repeat repairs per site, KPI window

models.name: mart_site_weekly
models.description: Weekly site performance for the service-network heatmap

models.name: mart_tco_vehicle
models.description: Total cost of ownership per vehicle in the KPI window

models.name: mart_time_in_service
models.description: Active fleet by time in service (age band) and powertrain

models.name: mart_vehicle_service_spend
models.description: Amount paid on each vehicle for services: visits, total spend by payer, goodwill and spend per 1,000 km

models.name: mart_vehicle_warranty
models.description: One row per vehicle: overall warranty position (Covered, Expiring, Partly covered, Out of warranty, Unknown), the next cover to end, and its add-ons (count, value, self-driving and electric equipment)

tests.name: t01_availability_in_range
tests.description: Availability is a percentage between 0 and 100

tests.name: t02_utilization_in_range
tests.description: Utilisation is between 0 and 100% when hours are supplied

tests.name: t03_no_negative_durations
tests.description: No negative turnaround or key-to-key time

tests.name: t04_vehicle_months_grain
tests.description: int_vehicle_months has exactly one row per vehicle per month

tests.name: t05_site_weekly_grain
tests.description: int_site_weekly has exactly one row per site per week

tests.name: t06_rating_in_range
tests.description: Every rating used in KPIs is 1-5 stars

tests.name: t07_book_value_bounds
tests.description: Book value never exceeds cost and never falls below the residual floor

tests.name: t08_depreciation_non_negative
tests.description: Monthly depreciation is never negative

tests.name: t09_recall_completion_bounded
tests.description: Recall completions never exceed affected vehicles

tests.name: t10_document_status_known
tests.description: Registration and insurance statuses are one of Valid, Expiring, Expired, Unknown

tests.name: t11_scorecard_covers_regions
tests.description: The executive scorecard has a row for every region active in the report month

tests.name: t12_leaderboard_scored
tests.description: Every ranked site has an Ops Score between 0 and 1,000 and a tier

tests.name: t13_productivity_plausible
tests.description: Productivity above 150% suggests technician headcount is understated

tests.name: t14_backlog_days_plausible
tests.description: More than 10 days of backlog suggests open jobs that were never closed in the source system

tests.name: t15_cost_reconciles
tests.description: Fleet-paid cost in the cost mart reconciles to the work orders for every region-month (within rounding)

tests.name: t16_parts_lead_time_valid
tests.description: Parts lead times are never negative and on-time is only judged for arrived parts

tests.name: t17_repeat_rates_bounded
tests.description: Repeat counts never exceed the visits and repairs they come from

tests.name: t18_handover_clocks_consistent
tests.description: The clocks add up: key-in to back-in-service equals workshop + pick-up + back-to-operations

tests.name: t19_service_spend_reconciles
tests.description: Service spend per vehicle reconciles to work orders on active vehicles

tests.name: t20_fines_reconcile
tests.description: Fine amounts in the monthly mart reconcile to the fines register

tests.name: t21_metric_network_identities
tests.description: The metric network's identities hold exactly: north star = visit rate x hours per visit; hours per visit = workshop + pick-up + back to ops + open; availability = 1 - north star / hours in a month; first visits = visits x (1 - repeat share)

tests.name: t22_metric_panel_matches_fleet
tests.description: The panel's exact availability agrees with the published availability KPI (to its 2-decimal rounding)

tests.name: t23_registry_one_row_per_vehicle
tests.description: The fleet register has exactly one row per vehicle

tests.name: t24_documents_drive_expiry
tests.description: A vehicle's registration and insurance expiry is never earlier than the latest matching document on file

tests.name: t25_driver_score_bounded
tests.description: Every driver safety score is between 0 and 100, and rates are never negative

tests.name: t26_alerts_reference_known_subjects
tests.description: Every alert names a known vehicle or driver

tests.name: t27_driver_compliance_consistent
tests.description: Every driver has a known compliance status, and fines attributed to drivers never exceed the fines on file

tests.name: t28_warranty_consistent
tests.description: Every warranty ends after it starts and has a known status, and every add-on belongs to a known vehicle position

tests.name: t29_gcc_compliance_consistent
tests.description: Every active vehicle has one GCC compliance row with a known status, and any vehicle not compliant says why
